title: Exercise Northstar: After Action
description: Exercise over. Now turn mountains of data into the report that shapes SAF training.
storyContext: Northstar's over; everyone's exhausted. But the Chief of Army wants a report — readiness, decision speed, logistics — in two weeks. Your findings shape SAF training for five years. Time to make the data talk.

software-engineer.title: Build the Review Tool
software-engineer.instruction: Generals want to replay the whole exercise on a timeline, like a video. How do you build it?
software-engineer.hint: Rich takes time. Simple ships fast. What do generals actually need?

options.label: Full replay with map, movements, and decision markers. Two weeks; commanders can rewatch everything.
options.consequence: Two weeks vanish, but generals scrub the timeline like a Netflix drama. Nobody leaves the room.

options.label: Charts, key-moment screenshots, auto-generated insights. Done in 3 days, easy to share. No replay.
options.consequence: Done in three days, forwarded to every unit by Friday. Not flashy — but everyone actually reads it.

options.label: AI picks the 20 most critical moments and analyses each. Fast, but may miss quiet moments.
options.consequence: The AI nails 18 of 20 key moments — and completely misses the quiet supply crisis. Humans still needed.

options.label: Shared timeline that unit commanders mark up with their own observations. Richer insights, slower to collect.
options.consequence: Commanders pile in with notes you'd never have found in the data. Worth every extra day.

data-scientist.title: Calculate Readiness Scores
data-scientist.instruction: One readiness score per unit, from GPS, supply, radio and decision data. Order the analysis steps.
data-scientist.hint: Agree what you're measuring before measuring. Check results against reality.

items.label: Scrub errors and duplicates from the raw data
Agree with planners what 'readiness' even means
Calculate each unit's score using that definition
Compare scores against human observer reports
Present to command with honest confidence levels

data-scientist.consequenceSuccess: Scores match what observers saw on the ground. Command trusts every number in your report.
data-scientist.consequenceFail: One unit scores 9/10 while its own commander calls it a shambles. Back to the definitions.

cloud-engineer.title: Estimate Storage Needed
cloud-engineer.instruction: The 14-day exercise's data must be archived. The graph shows daily terabytes for the last 4 days. Estimate the 14-day total plus 30% overhead.
cloud-engineer.hint: Total all 14 days from the trend, then multiply by 1.3.
cloud-engineer.consequenceSuccess: Storage arrives sized just right — every byte of Northstar archived for future trainees.
cloud-engineer.consequenceFail: The archive runs out of room on day 11. Someone has to delete drone footage. Painful.
